pk_core.name: pk_core
pk_core.reason: The exact compatible pk_core was not supplied with the v4.2.0 archive and was not reachable from this build. Pin it with `python3 core_probe.py pin` once supplied; release stays blocked until then.

production_path: vendored copy pinned by tree_sha256 and placed on PK_CORE_PATH (single authoritative path)
offline_recovery_path: the same vendored tree archived beside the release zip; verify with core_probe.py probe before use
transitives_note: INV-14 itself is standard-library only (verified by tools/sbom.py import scan). pk_core transitives are unknown until pk_core is pinned.
upgrade_policy: Any pk_core change requires: re-pin, core_probe probe OK, full test suite normal+optimized, 100-item assessment archive, and a recorded downgrade/rollback run to the previous pin before merge.
